subtitle: A flashcard app that brings back missed cards sooner.
about: A small app inside a Pinto Notes note, with flashcards that come back sooner or later depending on your answers. Ask your AI to make cards from your notes, or add and study them yourself.

ask.prompt: Set up the study notes and flashcards template in my Pinto Notes.

slides.label: Make cards from notes
slides.you: Here are my lecture notes on photosynthesis.
slides.ai: Made 5 flashcards under Photosynthesis, next to your cell respiration cards.
slides.alt: The flashcards: 12 cards in 2 topics, 6 due today

slides.label: Get quizzed
slides.ai: First one: what does the Calvin cycle fix?
slides.alt: The card: What does the Calvin cycle fix?

slides.label: Study yourself
slides.note: Or study and edit them yourself.
slides.alt: Studying a card: the answer, then Again, Hard, Good or Easy
